popup.title: Hills of Apion
popup.description: The hilly valley on the south-eastern side of the [[Akanapeaks]].

popup.title: Akanapeaks
popup.description: The mountain range in [[Chessenta]] that formed its historical western border.

popup.title: Aphrunn Mountains
popup.description: The mountain range that formed the southern border of the Republic of [[Turmish]].

popup.title: Broken Hills
popup.description: The rough and rugged plot of land immediately beyond Nimpeth's northeastern wall turned into the agricultural wonder of the [[Vilhon]] – [[Woren Vineyards]].

popup.title: Maerthwatch
popup.description: Also known as the '''Hills of Maerth''', a range of hills and mountains rich with [[beljuril]]s, [[jacinth]]s, and [[luspeel]].

popup.title: Adder Peaks
popup.description: A mountain range in [[Chessenta]]. Both the [[Winding River]] and [[Adder River]] originated in the '''Adder Peaks'''.

popup.title: Riders to the Sky
popup.description: The mountain range between southeastern [[Chessenta]] and northern [[Unther]], once home to an ancient [[aarakocra]] civilization.

popup.title: Smoking Mountains
popup.description: Also known as the '''Smoky Mountains''' or the '''Marthessel''', a range of mountains with active volcanoes.

popup.title: Council Hills
popup.description: A clump of hills in the [[Eastern Shaar]] where the territories of several Shaaran tribes met.

popup.title: Sword Mountains
popup.description: The barrier in [[Mulhorand]] between the [[Plains of Purple Dust]] and the rest of the nation.

popup.title: Unthangol Mountains
popup.description: A range of mountains located in the [[Old Empires]] area of [[Faerûn]], between southern [[Unther ]]and the [[Eastern Shaar]].

popup.title: Giant's Belt Mountains
popup.description: The mountains to the northeastern border of the [[Beastlands]] and [[Durpar]].

popup.title: Mountains of Copper
popup.description: A small mountain range that formed the northern border of [[Murghôm]], known for a large amount of [[copper]] ore found within.

popup.title: Curna Mountains
popup.description: The ''' Mountains of Wisdom''' that bordered [[Durpar]], [[Estagund]], [[Veldorn]], and [[Var the Golden]]. Famous of fabulous [[Curna emerald]]s and the [[Library of Curna]] –  a major center of worship for [[Curna]] within the [[Shining Lands]].

popup.title: Toadsquat Mountains
popup.description: Or the '''Little Mountains''', was an [[ogre]]-infested mountain range on the northern border of [[Luiren]].

popup.title: Gnollwatch Mountains
popup.description: A medium-small mountain range that ran east to west through [[Dambrath]] for approximately 700 miles and eventually declined and became the [[Hills of the Dead Kings]] in the east. The slopes of the mountains were covered in  [[shadowtop]]s, [[suthwood]], and [[pine]] [[tree]]s.

popup.title: Hills of the Dead Kings
popup.description: A hilly grassy region with occasional patches of [[pine]]s and [[shadowtop]]s in central [[Dambrath]], connected to the [[Gnollwatch Mountains]].

popup.title: Firesteap Mountains
popup.description: The mountain range that stretched from the edge of the [[Lake of Steam]] to the forest of [[Chondalwood]], then went on to the northern border of the [[Shaar]] and into the lands beyond.

popup.title: Rathgaunt
popup.description: A rocky outcropping located along the southern edge of the [[Shaar]].

popup.title: Wyrmbones
popup.description: A mountain range of note.

popup.title: Dun Hills
popup.description: A hill range between [[Lapaliiya]] and the [[Shaar]], part of the [[Channath Vale]].

popup.title: Muaraghal Mountains
popup.description: The '''East Wall''' mountains, also known as the '''Muaraghal Mountains''',  a range of mountains that formed the eastern border of [[Halruaa]].

popup.title: Nathaghal Mountains
popup.description: Also known as the [[North Wall]]. It formed [[Halruaa]]'s northern border and was home to dangerous creatures such as [[cyclopskin]], [[manticore]]s, [[roc]]s, [[cockatrice]]s, and [[medusa]]e.

popup.title: Halar Hills
popup.description: The region that sat at the base of the [[Lhairghal Mountains]]' eastern slope just north of the [[Swamp of Akhluar]].

popup.title: Lhairghal Mountains
popup.description: Also known as '''the West Wall''', were a range of mountains that formed the western border of [[Halruaa]].

popup.title: Delphin Mountains
popup.description: A small mountain range found in northern [[Tashalar]]

popup.title: Tashan Gap
popup.description: A rather wide mountain pass found in northern [[Tashalar]] measured nearly 80 miles.

popup.title: Hazur Mountains
popup.description: A small mountain range that served as the border between [[Tashalar]] and [[Thindol]].

popup.title: Guth Mountains
popup.description: A small mountain range in the southeast corner of [[Thindol]], home to colonies of dangerous [[blood ape]]s.

popup.title: High Peaks
popup.description: The western spur of the [[Cloven Mountains]].

popup.title: Omlarandin Mountains
popup.description: A mountain range in [[Tethyr]], richn in [[omlar]] [[gems]].

popup.title: Minthrux Vale
popup.description: A mountain vale between the [[Ruler's Ridge]] to the west and [[Mount Sarengard]] to the east.

popup.title: Tannath Mountains
popup.description: The southern part of the [[Dragonjaw Mountains]], starting south of the [[River Umber]].

popup.title: Sunrise Mountains
popup.description: The mountain range that formed much of that [[Thay]]'s eastern border.

popup.title: Khopet-Dag
popup.description: Also known as the '''Spiderhaunt Peaks''', was a mountain range located in the [[Endless Wastes]], famed for the [[giant spider]] [[silk]] gathered by the [[Yaqubi]] people.

popup.title: Thaymount
popup.description: The chain of volcanic mountains at the heart of [[Thay]], located within the [[tharch]] of the same name.

popup.title: Thesk Mountains
popup.description: Bare, inhospitable mountains in [[Thesk]] that reached as high as 7,000 feet (2,100 meters).

popup.title: Cape Dragonfang
popup.description: A minor peninsula – the westernmost point of the [[Dragonjaw Mountains]] that protruded into. the [[Easting Reach]].

popup.title: Dragonjaw Mountains
popup.description: Mountains in [[Thesk]] inhabited by [[gnome]]s and [[copper dragon]]s.

popup.title: Hill of Tombs
popup.description: The southernmost point in the [[Earthfast Mountain]] range, near the coast of the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]].

popup.title: Tejarn Hills
popup.description: A grouping of hills in southeastern [[Amn]] with its inhabitants believed to be country bumpkins by the citizens of [[Athkatla]] and [[Murann]].

popup.title: The Ridge
popup.description: A long stretch of cliffs found in the eastern [[Cloud Peaks]] and the most extensively mined area in [[Amn]].

popup.title: Small Teeth
popup.description: A mountain range that formed the border between [[Amn]] and [[Muranndin]], inhabited by [[goblinoid]]s, [[ogre]]s, [[kobold]]s, and [[hill giant]]s.

popup.title: Spine of the World
popup.description: A mountain range that stretched across the northwest region of [[Faerûn]] from the [[Cold Run]] near the [[Sea of Moving Ice]], to the [[Ice Spires]] north of the [[Silver Marches]].
popup.image: File:Spine of the world IWD map.png

popup.title: Hamlar Hills
popup.description: A cluster of the southern and western foothills of the [[Cloud Peaks]], the location of a vineyard planted by [[Vol Qirger]], and the small village of [[St. Carwell's Vale]].

popup.title: Growling Hill
popup.description: A landmark of note.

popup.title: Cloud Peaks
popup.description: The mountain range that marked the northern border of [[Amn]] inhabited by [[mountain goat]]s and reckless mountain climbers.

popup.title: Starspire Mountains
popup.description: A mountain range that stretched from the highlands of eastern [[Tethyr]] to a spur of the [[Starspire Penninsula]], inhabited by [[displacer beast]]s and [[peryton]]s.

popup.title: Snowflake Mountains
popup.description:
A mountain range that formed the borders between [[Tethyr]], [[Amn]], and [[Erlkazar]], once home to a great [[red dragon]] [[Fyrentennimar]]. Part of the [[Iltkazar Range]].

popup.description:
Three high plateaus that rose above the [[Shilmista]] forest, used as defensible high ground by the [[elves]] against monsters of the [[Snowflakes]].

popup.title: Daoine Dun
popup.description:
Also known as the '''Hill of the Stars''' – a hill that hid a large cavern complex used by [[elves]] for defense and as a ceremonial ground.

popup.title: Troll Hills

popup.title: Orbrekh

popup.title: Wild Hills
popup.description: A barren plot of land that stretched between the [[Lizard Marsh]] and the hamlet of [[Gillian's Hill]].

popup.title: Watchers of the North
popup.description: The line of hills that formed the northern border of the [[Forlorn Hills]].

popup.title: Rat Hills
popup.description: A stretch of coastline a short distance to the south of [[Waterdeep]], often used as a dump by the city.

popup.title: Dragonspine Mountains
popup.description: A range of peaks in the western [[Moonsea]], rich with natural resources, including a wealth [[ore]], and black [[granite]].

popup.description: A grouping of rocky hills and cliffs in the southern foothills of the [[Dragonspine Mountains]].

popup.title: Sumber Hills
popup.description: A range of hills in the middle of the [[Dessarin Valley]].

popup.title: Larch Hills
popup.description: Hills across the river from [[Sumber Hills]] across which the [[Dessarin Road]] moved northwards.

popup.title: Sword Mountains
popup.description: A range of arc-like peaks northwest of [[Waterdeep]] and east of the [[Mere of Dead Men]], home to [[orc]]s and [[troll]]s.

popup.title: Moonwatch Hills
popup.description: A grouping of rather unremarkable hills along the [[Phlan Path]].

popup.title: Vanishing Hills
popup.description: A grouping of hills, the source of the [[Trank River]], which ran south and opened up into the [[Twilight Marsh]] and the actual [[Moonsea]].

popup.title: Keldon Head

popup.title: Easthead
popup.description: One of the two rocky headlands that surrounded and sheltered the city of [[Hulburg]] and its harbors.

popup.title: Earthfast Mountains
popup.description: Or simply the '''Earthfasts,''' a small mountain range inhabited by [[shield dwarves]] and [[goblin]]s.

popup.description: Or simply the '''Earthspurs''', and sometimes named the '''Giantspike Mountains''' or the '''Dragonspike Mountains,''' a great mountain range in [[north Faerûn]] that bordered [[Damara]], [[Vaasa]], and [[Impiltur]] in the east with [[the Vast]] in the west.

popup.title: Troll Mountains
popup.description: Also known as the '''Trollcrag Mountains''', a small mountain range in [[the Vast]], running north of the [[River Vesper]] from the [[Dragon Reach]] in the west to the [[Earthspur Mountains]] in the east.

popup.title: Dagger Hills
popup.description: A hilly and rocky area south-east of [[Daggerdale]], sprinkled with sparse [[human]] hamlets and small farms, later overgrown with thickets and thorn fields and plagued by [[lycanthrope]]s in the century following the [[Spellplague]].

popup.title: Tarkhen Hills
popup.description: Rocky hills of note on the southwestern side of [[Daggerdale]] and the [[Tesh Valley]].

popup.title: Thrulaliel Mountains
popup.description: Mountain range at the far eastern edge of the [[Toadsquat Mountains]] in [[Luiren]]

popup.title: Marching Mountains

popup.title: Venom's Knoll
popup.description: A hilly stretch of note.

popup.title: Beluar's Hunt

popup.title: Hunter's Hills
popup.description: The foothills of the [[Desertmouth Mountains]].

popup.title: Shaddan Hills
popup.description: Hilly territory west of [[the Burn]], named after [[Shaddara the Fair]], the most famous queen of ancient [[Anauria]].

popup.title: Ice Mountains
popup.description: Also known as the '''Ruathym Mountains''', the mountain range location of [[Citadel Adbar]].

popup.title: Rauvin Mountains
popup.description: A small purple-hued mountain range located in the [[Silver Marches]].

popup.description: The dominant geographical feature within [[Samarach]] that provided a physical shield for the veiled kingdom, in addition to its magical mask.

popup.title: Tching Mountains

popup.description: Also known as '''Greypeaks''' or '''Gray Peaks''', a rugged and desolate mountain range famous for being exceptionally hard to traverse and home to many fearsome beasts, monstrous humanoids, and even aberrant beings that inspired terror in wary travelers.

popup.title: Berun's Hill

popup.title: Starmetal Hills

popup.title: Mistcliffs

popup.title: Lost Hills
popup.description: An especially perilous stretch of hills named for the magic that afflicted the region, which caused travelers to become hopelessly lost when passing within.

popup.title: Frost Hills

popup.title: Secret Place in the Sands
popup.description: A region of the [[Anauroch]] located south of the [[Quarter of Emptiness]].

popup.title: Firward Mountains
popup.description: A small mountain range found in [[Narfell]].

popup.title: Icerim Mountains

popup.title: Running Rocks

popup.title: Giantspire Mountains

popup.title: Lugsaas Chain

popup.title: Taurax Mountains
popup.description: Or '''Sunrise Mountains''', the mountain range that laid north of the [[Frozen Forest]] between the [[High Ice]] of the [[Anauroch]] to the west and the [[Great Glacier]] to the east.

popup.title: Ommlur Hills
popup.description: The foothills of the [[Small Teeth]] located on the west side of the [[Trade Way]], noted for their pristine beauty.

popup.title: Uthgardt Hills
popup.description: Also known as '''Wild Hills''' or "where the Barbarians hunt."

popup.title: Giantspine Range

popup.title: Grampalt Highlands

popup.title: Barrowfields

popup.title: Lisbunt Mountains
popup.description: A small mountain range of note.

popup.title: The Highfells

popup.title: Surykyk Range

popup.title: The Shieldmaidens

popup.title: Dessarin Hills

popup.title: Black Mountains

popup.title: Sugar Hills

popup.title: Dragon's Back Peaks
popup.description: A mountain chain of note.

popup.description: A small mountain chain of note.
